method: Root reviewer read all seven stylesheets, HTML/React entrypoints, TS/Vite configuration and verification documentation during the same review window as gateway-core. Reviewed responsive overflow, modal sizing/focus visibility, theme cascade, reduced-motion handling, CSS import inclusion, dev proxy origin preservation, build output ownership and historical evidence boundaries. Parsed all CSS with PostCSS and JSON/TS configuration; verified every byte hash against the frozen snapshot. Static source review only; no new visual/browser acceptance claim.
